lambda-no-vpc.fix: remove vpc_config: a Lambda in a VPC needs a NAT gateway or VPC endpoints to reach anything, and both bill by the hour

lambda-no-capacity-provider.fix: remove capacity_provider_config: Lambda Managed Instances run on EC2 and bill while idle; use the default on-demand Lambda

lambda-log-group.fix: add an aws_cloudwatch_log_group named "/aws/lambda/<function_name>" with retention_in_days 1-30, or Lambda creates one that never expires

esm-no-provisioned-poller.fix: remove provisioned_poller_config: provisioned event pollers bill by the hour

dynamodb-on-demand.fix: set billing_mode to "PAY_PER_REQUEST" (the default, PROVISIONED, bills for capacity while idle)

rest-stage-no-cache.fix: remove cache_cluster_enabled: a REST API cache cluster bills by the hour; cache in CloudFront instead

cloudfront-no-dedicated-ip.fix: set viewer_certificate.ssl_support_method to "sni-only": dedicated and static IPs carry a monthly charge

s3-lifecycle.fix: add an aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration for this bucket (expire or transition objects) so stored data does not grow without bound

log-retention.fix: set retention_in_days to a number from 1 to 30 (0 or missing means logs are kept forever)

ssm-standard-tier.fix: remove tier or set it to "Standard": Advanced parameters bill per parameter per month, and Intelligent-Tiering can promote to Advanced

kb-vector.fix: set knowledge_base_configuration.type to "VECTOR": KENDRA and SQL need an always-on index or warehouse, and MANAGED has no published scale-to-zero price

kb-s3-vectors.fix: set storage_configuration.type to "S3_VECTORS" with an aws_s3vectors_index: OpenSearch Serverless, RDS and Neptune Analytics bill while idle
